calculation.expression: clip(max(0, dispersion_t_minus_1 / rolling_quantile_252(dispersion_t_minus_1,0.75)-1),0,1) * (-residual_return_3d / volatility_20d), lagged one completed day
calculation.description: Cross-sectional three-day residual reversal with capped upper-tail dispersion intensity.
